data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'afshan', meaning 'pure, innocent, radiant'. In Islamic tradition, it is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl. The name Afshan carries the meaning “Pure, Innocent, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afshan usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Afshan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Innocent, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afshan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
